name: Prompt Eval

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  eval:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      DB_ENGINE: sqlite
      MOCK_LLM: "true"
      PYTHONPATH: .
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Check eval suite exists
        id: gate
        run: |
          if [ -f tests/eval_suite.py ] && [ -f data/eval_dataset.json ]; then
            echo "ready=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "ready=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::eval_suite.py or eval_dataset.json not present yet, skipping"
          fi

      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v5
        if: steps.gate.outputs.ready == 'true'

      - name: Install dependencies
        if: steps.gate.outputs.ready == 'true'
        run: uv sync --frozen --extra dev

      - name: Run evaluation suite
        if: steps.gate.outputs.ready == 'true'
        run: uv run python tests/eval_suite.py | tee eval_report.md

      - name: Upload report
        if: steps.gate.outputs.ready == 'true'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: eval-report
          path: eval_report.md
